params.name: entityId
params.description: The UUID of the Platform entity

items.docs: Returns purpose-grouped attachment limits (MIME allow-lists, per-file size caps, count caps). Frontend uses these to drive dropzone `accept`, size validation, and count gating without duplicating constants. `general` applies to comments and feed attachments; `termsAndConditions` is narrower (2 MB / 5 files, strict MIME set).

params.name: entityId
params.description: The UUID of the Platform entity

items.docs: Returns the configured MIME allow-list, per-file size cap, per-request file count cap, and per-receipt active count cap. The frontend uses these to drive dropzone `accept`, size validation, and count gating without duplicating constants.
